metadata.title: Mediating effects of motivation and socioeconomic status on reading achievement: a secondary analysis of PISA 2018

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study used ten plausible values and applied Rubin's rules for handling them.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that it used student weights in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study ran uni-level SEM models without accounting for school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: There is no mention of any validation strategy beyond the estimation sample.
